title: Employees with the same title
statementMd:
Find pairs of different employees with the same job title. List each pair once (first names alphabetical inside the pair) with the title.

Expected columns: `employee_a`, `employee_b`, `title`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT a.first_name AS employee_a, b.first_name AS employee_b, a.title FROM employees a JOIN employees b ON a.title = b.title AND a.id < b.id;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
